mrd.retrospective_population: Identified patient/visit groups with selected marrow rows, including missing results
mrd.circall_population: Identified patients with at least one nonmissing follow-up clinical MRD result
mrd.pooled_denominator: Fixed union of source-specific MRD populations; complete nominal visit grid; no enrolled-cohort denominator

retrospective.identity_rule: Case-sensitive trimmed surname within count source only; no inventory linkage

circall.identity_rule: Recorded protocol ID; count-source namespace, separate from MRD

counts.duplicate_rule: Reject repeated measured subject/day/measurement; no averaging
counts.missing_cache_rule: Formula count/day without a saved result is unavailable, not zero; measured counts require an integer day
counts.full_range: All selected observed counts, using diagnostic display baseline then recorded days; early-window view is separate

rules.source_annotations: Selected inventory/donor literal missing and unknown markers standardized to na; historical aliases remain readable. Clinical uncertain significance is unchanged.
rules.scope: Descriptive disease tracking only; normalized modeling disabled
rules.integrity: Whole-cohort inventory gate, selected controls included; additional clinical/count errors block affected cohort; reviews permit execution
rules.identity: Recorded patient_id/circall_id for inventory MRD; isolated legacy surname basis for retrospective counts; no name fallback or cross-modality/cohort linkage
rules.eligibility: Clinical annotations independent of plasma receipt, cfDNA availability and sample visit for CIRCALL metadata
rules.unknown: Unknown source marker is unavailable, distinct from clinical uncertain significance
rules.normalization: No baseline normalization of recorded counts; assumed MRD reference and categorical positions are display conventions only
rules.privacy: No patient-level MRD/count tables, identifiers, names, DOB or notes exported, including audit; source observations reconstructed in memory for validation
rules.pooling: Compatible MRD descriptions only, both cohorts with retained MRD populations; count comparisons retain separate cohort trajectories and denominators
